blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipality of Santa Maria in this province was placed under a state of calamity early this week due to extensive damage to agricultural crops caused by a prolonged drought associated with Super El Niño, with losses estimated at over P48 million. Mayor Michael Florendo, who sought the declaration, said the move was based on an assessment by the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) and the Municipal Agriculture Office on Nov. 6. The assessment showed that 656.99 hectares of agricultural land mostly planted with rice, corn and eggplants had been affected by the […]...
